一、【参考解答】 等效势能函数

(1) 螺线管内部磁场

$$B = \mu_{0} n I = \mu_{0} n k t\tag{1}$$

在外部r处产生感生电场，水平向左

$$E = \frac{\pi R^{2}}{2 \pi r} \frac{\partial B}{\partial t} = \frac{\mu_{0} n k R^{2}}{2 r}\tag{2}$$

以螺线管中心为原点，竖直向下为极轴方向建立极坐标系，顺时针为角度正方向，则粒子在感生电场中发生小位移 $(r,\theta) \to (r + \mathrm{d}r,\theta + \mathrm{d}\theta)$ 时，感生电场做功:

$$\mathrm{d}W = \vec{F} \cdot \mathrm{d}\vec{r} = rqE\mathrm{d}\theta = \frac{q\mu_{0}nkR^{2}}{2}\mathrm{d}\theta\tag{3}$$

于是有等效势能函数:

$$U_{\mathrm{eff}} = - \frac{q \mu_{0} n k R^{2}}{2} \theta\tag{4}$$

碰撞时极角为:

$$\theta_{0} = \frac{l}{R}\tag{5}$$

能量守恒:

$$E = \frac{1}{2}mv^{2} + mgz + U_{eff} = \frac{1}{2}mv^{2} - mgR\cos\left(\frac{l}{R}\right) - \frac{q\mu_{0}nkRl}{2} = 0 + mg(-l - R) + 0\tag{6}$$

解得

$$v = \sqrt{\frac{q\mu_{0}nkRl}{m} - 2g\left(l + R - R\cos\left(\frac{l}{R}\right)\right)}\tag{7}$$

假设质子动量为，则由动量守恒，x粒子动量为 $p_{p}$

$$p_{x} = \sqrt{p_{p}^{2} + p_{e}^{2} - p_{p}p_{e}}\tag{6}$$

能量守恒

$$\sqrt{p_{x}^{2}+m_{x}^{2}}+\sqrt{p_{p}^{2}+m_{p}^{2}}+\sqrt{p_{e}^{2}+m_{e}^{2}}=m_{m}\tag{7}$$

结合两式解得

$$m_{n}=\sqrt{\left(m_{n}-\sqrt{p_{e}^{2}+m_{e}^{2}}-\sqrt{p_{p}^{2}+m_{p}^{2}}\right)^{2}-\left(p_{p}^{2}+p_{e}^{2}-p_{p}p_{e}\right)^{2}}\tag{8}$$

卡西欧打表得

$$m_{max} = 0.37912 \mathrm{MeV}/c^{2}\tag{9}$$

(3)同第二问中，有能量守恒

$$\sqrt{p_{p}^{2}+p_{e}^{2}-p_{p}p_{e}}+\sqrt{p_{p}^{2}+m_{p}^{2}}+\sqrt{p_{e}^{2}+m_{e}^{2}}=m_{n}\tag{10}$$

解得

$$p_{p}=0.62990\mathrm{MeV/c}\tag{11}$$

设夹角的余角为 $\phi$ ，则由动量首尾相接得到的三角形知

$$\phi = \arctan \frac{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} p_p}{p_e - \frac{1}{2} p_p}\tag{12}$$

于是代入计算得

$$\pi - \phi = 1.9013 \mathrm{rad} = 108.94^{\circ}\tag{13}$$
